newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, prompt mogas sales continue.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, prompt mogas sales continue.

text.p: NWE oil products all softened on Thursday, in response to weaker futures, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were about $2 a tonne weaker. One prompt eurograde barge, to be delivered by April 25, traded at $188.50 fob AR.

The seller has consistently offered barges in the past week. Some traders said the trading house still had plenty of product to shift from Amsterdam. Others said lower numbers suited its swaps position.
Another barge, loading in the first half of May, was sold at $193.
Prompt offers for Rotterdam running refinery material were at $190.
Heating oil barges were very slightly lower as IPE gas oil futures softened. Offers for prompt product held at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam. One barge traded at May +75 cents.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were offered at $82, bid at $81, a decline of $1 a tonne.
Bunker market demand was under 10,000 tonnes.
